Dear all,

I am trying to do a mediation model in Lavaan. I have two continuois variables and one binary variable (the outcome). I also need to use the cluster function to controll for the relatedness of the sample.

Here my model:

mod <- "# a path
         MEDIATOR ~ a * X


         # b path
         OUTCOME_BINARY ~ b * MEDIATOR

         # c prime path
         OUTCOME_BINARY ~ cp * X


         # indirect and total effects
         ab := a * b
         total := cp + ab"
fsem2 <- sem(mod2, data = df,  cluster = "ClusterVariable")

I cannot use ordered=T 

So, I just wondered how can I use a binary variable and control for the relatedness of the sameple?
